reviews.text: Top shelf vets and staff.
We’ve been taking our baby boy Gus here since we got him. It’s been four years now still very happy with the service they take good care of him especially when he’s anxious.

Dr. Alexandra and the staff in this clinic are kind, patient and understanding. Dr. Alexandra listens to you attentively, asks questions about the pet’s issues, diagnoses the condition, prescribes necessary medications and provides one if you prefer to get it right away instead of going home and ordering the meds elsewhere.
I was new to the area and feel lucky I brought my cat here. The front staff, the vet tech, the vet, everyone was wonderful. Kind, patient, explained everything… I highly recommend them!
Great service, we are very thankful

Had a great experience, we didn’t wait long at all and everyone was kind and helpful. Dr. West made me feel heard,  answered all my questions and explained the course of treatment to me perfectly making sure I felt comfortable with everything. The vet tech who came to give my cat her meds was very kind and gentle. Everyone who interacted with my baby was friendly and calm which made us both  feel at ease. I would recommend BFAH to all my friends and family.

Edit (9/16/26): We brought our cat back for his yearly checkup. Dr. Noda and all other staff were excellent.

Staff members were passionate, communicative, nice, professional, and quick. We’ll happily be bringing our cat here in the future.
Wonderful doctors and staff. I’ve especially enjoyed my interactions with Megan. She’s kind, competent, and compassionate. My little dog is very comfortable at Best Friends.

I am so very grateful, happy and pleased that I chose BF Animal Hosp to bring my semi feral cat Taffy in for an exam. Everyone in the office, Dr Vaughan and those who carried the heavy cage for me were so very kind and helpful. This was a first visit for us and we will return for teeth cleaning and X-rays soon. It wasn't easy to teach Taffy how to get into the carrier, but so relieved when I did. Wonderful Vet is now our Best Friend. !Now in 2026 Taffy was in for Dental cleaning and had back teeth extracted done very well by Dr West. Recuperating at home doing well. So grateful for everyone in BFAH keeping me informed and available for any further problems.
Super attentive and available vet, great location, friendly staff.

Best friends was recommended highly from a friend of ours and has not disappointed. Our puppy is four months old and so far he’s getting the best care possible at this facility. Our vet, Brit, in particular is amazing.
Very efficient, clean Vet hospital with great staff and Veterinarians.

Everyone at Best Friends is so caring and attentive. They are all clearly animal lovers, so they clearly understand and empathize with the pet owners that come through for help for their furry companions. Our girl Louie is the cat who owns our heart and when she's not feeling her best, we know that by taking her to Best Friends, she will receive the best treatment.

I can’t express enough gratitude for the care I received at Best Friends Animal Hospital during a really stressful time with my dog, Bugsy. A lot of other places I reached out to weren’t able to take me in as a last-minute emergency client, but this clinic still made space for us and treated us with real compassion and urgency when we needed it most.

Dr. O was kind, professional, and made sure I understood everything clearly without ever making me feel rushed. You can tell there is genuine care for the animals here, not just routine treatment.

The front desk girl, Jackie, was also very kind and helpful. She allowed us to come in early morning and even helped me out with something when she didn’t have to. She made the check-in process smooth and welcoming, which helped ease a lot of my stress right away.

But I especially want to highlight Julio, the nurse technician, because he truly went above and beyond in every way. He wasn’t just kind to Bugsy—he was extremely understanding of my financial situation and made a real effort to help me stay within a reasonable budget. That is rare to find. He didn’t try to push unnecessary costs or overwhelm me with options I couldn’t afford. Instead, he actually took the time to explain everything clearly and helped me prioritize what Bugsy truly needed.

What stood out most was that he genuinely went out of his way to make things easier for me. He was patient, reassuring, and made me feel like I wasn’t alone trying to figure everything out. In a moment where I was stressed and worried about both my dog and the cost of care, Julio made a huge difference by being so thoughtful and compassionate.

People like him are rare—he truly cares about animals and the people who love them, not just the job itself.

Overall, I’m beyond grateful to the entire team at Best Friends Animal Hospital for their care, kindness, and fairness, especially during an emergency situation. I would absolutely recommend them.

So grateful for all of the staff here, especially Dr. Noda who has incredible bedside manner - she is always caring, thoughtful, and honest. Overall we have had good experiences here with both our pets and have not had issues with booking appointments or waiting long to be seen. Parking is very convenient and easy which is a big plus when you are traveling with an animal. I would saying the pricing is reasonable for LA and given the level of treatment they provide.
Been taking my pets here for years and they are great. Very thorough, caring, and helpful in any situation.

My dog is a patient here. I feel comfortable and the staff is nice so far. I been to other vets where I dealt with rude staff. I love the follow up phone calls after my visit. Thank you for caring for my doggy Marshmellow 🙏🙏🙏

I recently moved to Valley Village and needed a vet closer to home - I’m so glad I found Best Friends Animal Hospital. It was easy to schedule an appointment, and every person I encountered was kind. I loved Dr. Noda (and the vet tech)’s bedside manner. She took her time with my cat, answered all my questions, and even sought out a second opinion from a colleague to ensure we had the best treatment recommendation before I left... An estimate was presented and clearly explained before we proceeded. Highly recommend.
Super friendly vets, explained everything well, overall great experience and we'll be taking our dog back here for future vet visits!

We have gone to Best Friends for over 15 years and they have been wonderful. Dr. Heim and Dr. West are extraordinary vets. Kind , compassionate and a credit to the field. We have gone for monthly shots for the last 2 years and the vet tech’s have always been just wonderful with our blind little girl. We had to put down our beloved angel this weekend and Dr.West went out of his way to make it happen in the kindest way possible. I’m forever grateful for all of the kindness’s the staff has given us with our aging pups and willingness to work with us in navigating their care.

I showed up at this hospital in a panic. My dog was not doing well, and the staff was very friendly and helpful. There was a male and a female, and they very quickly asked me all the questions to get my dog in the back and looked at. They were very friendly very helpful. They did not make me feel bad about being so concerned about my fur baby. This place is really great.

I am incredibly grateful to Best Friends Animal Hospitals for the exceptional care they provided to my doggie Luna. Dr. West is an outstanding doctor — professional, attentive, and truly compassionate. Luna was in the best hands during her surgery, and that peace of mind means everything.
A very special thank you to Gonzalo, the vet tech, whose kindness, professionalism, and genuine care truly stood out. You can feel how much he cares about both the animals and their owners.
Highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for excellent and compassionate care.

We have been coming to Best Friends Animal Hospital for 8 years and now bring our second pup here as well. The care is always excellent. Each doctor, vet tech and front staff is helpful, caring and compassionate.  We needed some dental cleanings and bigger surgeries this year and I knew the pups were in very capable hands, and I was less anxious about the surgery because of this. I especially love the close follow up after each appointment. They are also very quick to respond to emails and messages. Thankful to have such a great vet!

Tofu, my 10 yo chihuahua/terrier with 8 teeth, went in for pain. He cried all morning but especially when touched.

When examined the next day, there was no pain anywhere. We think he had pulled a muscle.
All the vet's are gentle and caring. As well as the technicians. Nicest people you could ever meet.

Upon leaving, Tofu became very happy.
He jumped on the chair and down again. Idk.

Be sure to give them gifts like candy. They deserve it and our business.
Wouldn't take my Cats anywhere else. Incredible Vets and extremely helpful and caring Staff.

Our dog got cut on a fence requiring stitches. We saw Dr. Osmundson who was gentle and direct with path of treatment. We were able to get our girl back in a few hours, happy and stitched. Thank you to BFAH staff and Dr. O! We've been going to Best Friends for 5 years and highly recommend them.
Legitimate, loving, and knowledgeable.

We had an appointment for a health certificate to travel and they are great at it. They made sure my pet was comfortable with the exam and took time to answer all of our questions! The facility is very clean and organized.
I love this hospital! All the staff are so empathetic.  They always listen to me and take my opinions into account.  Thank you BFAH!
Everyone was so nice and helpful. Gave many options on what to do to help stay in budget.

I took my dog in October 2025 for an ear infection. They gave me some medication charged me and left.! After his medication was done, I noticed he started bumping into walls. Come to find out. He has an eye infection in his right eye and a cataract in his left eye I took him back.To get his up to date Rabies shot and to check out his eye and told them I was moving to Las Vegas very next day they told me he had blood in his right eye, and I would have to make another appointment to come back and run some test. I told them I’m moving. They really didn’t care about. My dog it is all about money. I’m in Las Vegas can’t afford a vet bill again till next month so I went online and ordered some antibiotic eyedrop for my dog. Come to find out after I paid it I needed a prescription from the animal clinic contacted best friends animal Hospital and they refused to OK the prescription for eyedrop. I guess they think it is better for my dog to lose his eye or to die instead of a stupid prescription. Do yourself a favor find some other place, that that will stick behind you And have your back when it comes to your animals health!!!!!

I’ve never loved a vet for my cat until now. In fact, I thought I’d never find a vet I loved. This office is amazing. The front desk staff are so genuine, kind and helpful. The lobby is clean, modern and simple. The exam room was also well-kept and even included thoughtful little amenities. Krista was so sweet bringing us back to the room and offering a squeezy treat for Rupert to calm him down. And she was really gentle with him too. And then Dr. West. DR. WEST!! He took the time to have a conversation with me about all of the concerns I had. He offered ideas for solutions and possibilities of the outcomes. And he was honest about which course of treatment might be best for early stages. He genuinely cared about helping me and my cat. After the appointment I requested for him to be our permanent doctor. I’m so grateful I found Best Friends and Dr. West. I finally feel hopeful about my cat’s health for the long term 😌
Excellent service my pop is feeling great like never did before

OVER-D-TOP EXCELLENT IN EVERY WAY!  M'pooch was really messed-up. Everything from reception booking appointment ASAP, to support staff provideing every detail with assureing smiles, to Dr. Vaughan's expert assessment with patience & care in every step, X-rays, lab, meds, EVERYTHING, in a CLEAN/FULL SERVICE, modern facility. At fair price given the quality, + even free/abundant parking on-site. M'lill guuurl got 1st-class attention, 100% satisfied, THANK YOU BFAH!!!  Sincerely ....

I really really appreciated Dr. West's thoroughness and sensitivity with my cat. The clinic was clearly busy but he still took his time to examine her and listen to me. Grateful to establish her care here!

Editting to add that I've now worked with multiple staff members here and they've all been fantastic! My cat needed an unplanned procedure today discovered during her wellness visit and they made the entire process very smooth, gentle on my baby, and incredibly safe and informative. I'm so grateful I found this place <3

Best friends animal hospital helped me with preparing my dog for overseas travel to Europe and they were extremely knowledgeable in the process. They took care of us and our dog very well. I would strongly encourage this vet for all your pet’s medical needs and medical travel preparation.

Dr. Wright is so kind and caring. We have been trying to find a vet that cares and we can trust and BFAH has been amazing! Everyone who works there is great! I feel better informed about what my dog has been dealing with health wise and am very grateful to have found this place.
Dr Wright always has a wonderful bedside manner. The staff is always nice.

We have been with Best Friends for many, many years. In that time, they have cared for 9 of our dogs and two cats. All the staff there are top-notch, well-informed, kind, caring people. We primarily interact with Dr. Heim, but any other vets or techs our pets have relied on for care have been knowledgeable, expert clinicians and providers. Dr. Heim has earned a special place in our hearts and our family. She is our guiding light when it comes to our fur family. When folks say I would trust them with my family, that is literally what we do. I can't imagine how we could have managed our beautiful family without her, the staff, and the warm milieu she has created at the clinic.
I adore the team at BFAH. They’re so thorough and caring - I would recommend to anyone

Best Friends Animal Hospital has been taking the best of care of our pets for years. They have helped a few transition over the Rainbow Bridge and helped us bring a few new babies into our world happy and healthy. From the moment you walk in the front door of the entire staff is absolutely amazing. From some of our saddest outcomes their due to health issues with their pets to our joyous days there with our new Pets, the staff in its entirety truly has cared about the health of our loved ones.  Thank you from the Chisnalls and Duck, Goose, Trouble, and Tricks.

Terrible and devastating experience after being with them for 4 years!
My puppy was bitten by an aggressive dog in front of the clinic, almost inside! (that dog was going out of the clinic after the exam) and while my dog was bleeding they took him inside and brought back shaking and told me I have to schedule an appointment!

After explaining to the staff that it’s about my dog’s health and not the money, after raising my voice and explaining it happened in their clinic and it’s an emergency situation, the director of the clinic/doctor finally decided to check my dog after an hour (afraid of any responsibility). She didn’t do anything, asked to bring the dog back in a week and told me they are not going to charge for a check up visit. And guess what! When the check up day came after waiting for almost 2 hours, after learning my dog has some side effects, she decided she had to leave and someone else examined my dog for a minute, asked 2 stupid questions, did not do anything and they charged me again! This happened not once, the only thing they care about is money! I saw several pets in critical condition waiting for hours and being told no one can examine the pets that day. The front office manager could not be less caring, uneducated and rude! The worst service and experience!

Dr. Tracy Noda helped me and my 8-year old cat. The Dr. was very thorough in her explanation of my cat's anatomy and gave several possible scenarios of why my cat's medical condition was occurring.  I opted for a plan that took baby steps (since my cat wasn't in pain and not in dire health) though a more aggressive plan was also available to me.  The cost was reasonable compared to other animal hospitals and considering the time and services given to my cat. I think Dr. Noda is thoughtful and draws upon  experience and common sense to make diagnostic decisions. I recommend her.

I just got two precious little brother and sister kitties. I took them here for their first couple of appointments since it was so close to home. My bill was much higher than I was used to paying at Animal Clinic in Encino. I am paying for health insurance for both kitties this time around. We'll see if that helps any. I do really like the doctor they saw there, she was very caring and knowledgeable. I miss Dr. Chang , I wish she was closer to where I live.

The vet was incredibly nice and thorough.  We have a new kitten and she explained all of the shots needed in addition basic daily care.  They gave my kitten a treat she enjoyed while being examined.  The facility is very clean.  Parking is a bit limited but we didn’t have an issue with getting a space.  All of the staff were helpful. And we got 50% off our first exam.
I found a cat on the street and brought it here to be assessed. Best Friends was sooo helpful and understanding. The vet was knowledgeable and walked me through the recommended next steps.

We've been seeing Dr. Erica Heim since 2011. Her and her staff are excellent. We love all of the guidance and the care she gives to our fur babies. Within the last 13 years, we've had two of our babies pass away and the support we received from them, from the time of the emergency to their deaths, were genuine and sincere. We have always felt like we're visiting the family doctor in our little town back home.  Our Luca (Chihuahua) passed away 12/18/19 and before he passed, they did as much as they could to save him but once the trachea collapses at his senior age, it would be too risky. Our other Chihuahua, Moses was struck by a vehicle 11/08/24 and Best Friends was there to console us through his tragic death. Their support was so comforting as we just lost our 5 year old son. We were here today for all of our dogs' annual wellness exams. Dr. Heim is always very thorough with her exams as well as understanding (with our financial situation) and always explains everything with honesty. Since they have always been her patients throughout the years, it's great to see that nothing has changed. We really like the itemization of their billing system and how everything is reviewed with us before any procedures are done. We will always be loyal to Best Friends Animal Hospital for years to come. This is why we won't go anywhere else.
Best Friends always takes good care of our three cats. Their doctors and techs and staff are all friendly and helpful. And they always take cost into account when offering treatment options.

Parking was thankfully available at our 2:30 Tues appt. All areas were clean and welcoming. A Tech/Asst. called on us right at our scheduled time. Very patient with us trying to get our energetic pug to stay/sit on the scale mat (which is on the ground, instead of just the table scales). Once inside the exam room they asked about any concerns and let us ask ALL our questions. We don't ever feel rushed here. Then we were seen by the Vet/Dr. for the exam. This was a diff Dr from his normal doc (in the same facility), but she was just as amazing with our baby. She addressed all our concerns, answered all our questions, and let us know the Tech would return shortly with an itemized estimate. There was a little bit of a wait at this point but we weren't in a hurry. The etimate was provided for services that were already scheduled, as well as services/meds recommended for our additional concerns. We were also provided with options to break up the services into multiple visits if needed. Once we signed off we waited again a little bit longer. The tech returned to take our pup to the back for his work needed. They said it would be about 30min, so we walked across the street for a quick bite to eat. When we got back they told us how he did. When he (our pup) became too anxious they stood down and let him relax and did not continue with any treatments he couldn't handle. They prescribed a mild sedative for us to give him before his next visit to administer those uncomfortable services next time. I love that they are so conscientious about our pets emotional safety and never use unnecessary force. They charged us only for what they were able to complete. Our boy came out looking not too freaked out, just happy to see us again.

We had to move out of town and are too far to travel to our favorite vet. We and Penny and Jonesy will miss the wonderful care our cat kids received at Best Friends, Valley Village. There is no better veterinary care than Best Friends, Valley Village. ❤️

I recently had the most wonderful experience taking both of my senior cats to Best Friends Animal Hospital for their physical exams and vaccinations! From the moment we arrived, the staff was incredibly kind and loving towards my furry companions. Their warmth and friendliness made the entire process so much easier for both me and my cats. I truly felt heard and safe in their care, which is so important for any pet owner. I can’t express how grateful I am for the exceptional service we received. Best Friends Animal Hospital has won my heart, and I wholeheartedly recommend them to anyone seeking top-notch care for their pets!

First time at Best Friends and was impressed.  Nice staff and really liked Dr. Amanda, she took her time checking my Lily and explained everything, she even got back to me next day with blood results.  Gave me alternatives instead of paying for expensive treatments that I can’t afford.  They were reasonable in pricing and got 1/2 off for first checkup visit.  My baby Lily has a new place for her care.  Will recommend to friends and family.  Shout out to Bow Wow Grooming for recommending Best Friends to me.
They treat your animal. They don’t look for the extra buck.

Great staff - friendly and efficient vets . Treated our mini schnauzer like a king!
Rates are great as well
Would recommend

Dr. Susanna Osmundson was very knowledgeable and very great to my little boy (cat). The whole staff was! Snowy was a bit scared from the car ride, smells of other animals, and new environment, but when in the exam room they all made him feel comfortable and eventually he felt good enough to even explore the room a bit. Mostly, I really liked the knowledge Dr. Osmundson had (more than other vets) and I liked how she handled and related with Snowy. I also really liked how the tech (nurse?) was with Snowy. They treated him like the beautiful fluffy boy he is and not like some “patient” or thing-to-examine/job. They’re helping us get ready to move to Europe, but I do wish I found them earlier. If we were staying in L.A. I’d definitely make them Snowy’s regular doctor.

We love Best Friends.
They have been taking great care of our cats for over 25 years.
We highly recommend them.
Extremely pleased with our first visit.  Friendly, gentle, clean, and informative. No one was pushy or condescending. Exactly what we were hoping to find in a veterinarian practice.

Dr. Heim, Dr. Osmundson, and Julio are amazing! Both of my kitties go to them, but most recently one of my cats got diagnosed with kidney disease and they have been so informative and helpful. Of course I had a million questions, and they were patient with me and advised the best treatment plan for my kitty. I am so thankful for them!

I do not recommend this institution… People are not responsible… They only care about money and reviews… Our cat Vovasik, whom we wanted to take with us to Ukraine, did not survive the vaccination done in this so-called “clinic”… When I said that the cat died, they answered me: “OK, Welcome “…..😢😢😢 …

Dr Dan West is the best! He took care of our two cats, Tucker and Rocket. Thank you for taking the time to explain in detail the care for the two of them. We appreciate you taking care of our pet family!
I have been using for 9 years.  I wouldn't go anywhere else! Always the very best in every way!

I went there cause my cat and dog both have a teeth problem. I ended up paying 1300 for vaccines, flee control and antibiotics for my dog. But they didn't treat the original problem that I was going for. I feel ripped off and disappointed. I also received an outrageous quote for his dental procedure which is more than double of what the standard price for this procedure is: 4600 for the procedure for the dog and 3870 for the teeth removal for my cat..... I don't think I will be coming back:
Dr. West and the entire staff are super professional,  friendly and very competent! We just got 2 new kitties and we will entrust their care to Best Friends. We strongly recommend them!
We’ve taken our pets here for years now, cats and dogs. They are very thorough, no matter which vet or tech you see. Highly recommend!

The kindness and empathy Dr. Noda and the staff showed us from the minute we arrived was unmatched We were not expecting it and It really did help us cope with the loss of our sweet little Lulu thank you Blanca, Ollin, and Roxy.
Great team! Always friendly

My cat was shy but comfortable
That says a lot about the staff they are really good with animals
So I gave my cat a treat for good behavior

I recently visited this veterinary clinic with my cat and couldn't be happier with the experience. The staff went above and beyond to ensure my cat remained calm throughout the visit. Despite my cat's loud meowing and obvious distress, the team was incredibly understanding and patient. They spoke to him in soothing tones and offered him gentle reassurances, which made a world of difference. It was clear that they truly care about the animals in their care. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone seeking a compassionate and attentive veterinary team!
P.S. Loki’s mummy
I took my dog for a yearly check up. We had an appointment and were seen quickly. Both nurse and vet were great, and we'll be back.
Knowledgeable, kind and considerate staff and doctors. A great place to take your pet.
Hi Jeff, Thank you for this excellent review and your kind words!

Not only is this place very expensive, they either don’t know what they’re doing or they’re trying to trick people into spending money. I took my dog there because he suddenly was not able to get up, walk, eat or drink water. They told me my dog would need emergency surgery and it would need to be completed in a different facility. I cried because there was no way I would be able to afford a last minute surgery and thought I would need to put him down. It was devastating! The vet ends up giving me an alternative option of sending home meds and seeing if that would work; well what do you know? My dog recovered within a couple of days and has been fine since! This was about 2 years ago and he still has no issues. Recently I took both my dogs for their vaccines and flea treatment, and again, very expensive visit. About 2 weeks later or so, I get 2 envelopes in the mail from the city, one for each of my dogs. Turns out the vet reported us to the city! WOW! I’m not sure the reason but my guess is that it was because my two dogs were not neutered. They already charged me an arm and a leg and now they want to force me back to have my dogs neutered with them? Shady way to get money, but guess what Best Friends? I took my dogs somewhere else and had surgery done there 2 weeks ago. If you have money to throw away, this is the place for you. But if you’re looking for an honest ethical veterinarian, there’s others out there that care more for your pets and your financial situation.

Excellent! Our first visit and I'm so glad to have found them. Dr. Heim and the entire staff were impressive and kind. All my questions were answered clearly, and I got a follow-up call the next day to see how my cat was feeling. The office was very clean and there was enough parking.
Such a wonderful vet practice. They give great care and are so nice. It's a lovely place that you can trust. I particularly like Dr. Wright.

Our 4 legged Family is always treated Great and are always in good hands.
Dr. Heim is the Best and her team is Wonderful and always so helpful!!

Ive been going here for years. They've given my brand new kittens their shots, they gave my oldest his final exam. You can trust them. I can afford their care. In the end, that's all that matters to me. Recommended.

New to the area and so happy I found Best Friends Animal Hospital for my cat! Booked for a general health check and for flea medication. Dr. Heim was lovely! So compassionate and took her time examining my cat and asking questions about him. Nothing felt rushed or unnecessary. She made a health plan for him and made sure I was comfortable with everything. Pricing is fair and not pushy. The staff is wonderful and everyone was kind when speaking to me and handling my cat. I won’t be trying other vets as I found the best one for my boy!
The doctors and staff are fantastic. Dr Wright is so great with my pets. I recommend going here

I love Best Friends, and now that we go here I’ll never go anywhere else. Every vet we’ve ever seen has been kind and attentive with our cat, and the whole staff really go above and beyond when possible to help us out. I love how caring and personal going to Best Friends feels, after having some less than great experiences in the past. Thank you BFAH!

I’ve been going to Best Friends for almost 20 years. This week I took my cat Pax in where he was treated by Dr. Heim. She was so wonderful. He got the works! And, he’s been so happy since we got him with clean ears, clean other things and yummy new food. Thank you!

Every vet I have seen here is very thorough, caring, and attentive to deal. My cat is very anxious and vet visits are difficult and scary for her but I completely trust the staff here to handle her and take care of her. They always follow up after visits and the doctors explain everything well.

Dr. Vaughan has taken care of my two cats for almost 5 years. She is an excellent veterinarian and I trust her completely. When I am unable to see Dr. Vaughan, the other veterinarians who I have also seen at Best Friends are consummate …

They literally Traumatized my cat, me, have no regard for people's schedules and when management changed last year went completely downhill in care. The staff is highly untrained and unprofessional and the behind the exam rooms is total …
